component.name: Dorado
component.summary: The modern spiritual successor to Microsoft Zune Desktop

description.p: Dorado is a cross-platform media player and library manager for Windows and Linux, built as an authentic re-creation of the Microsoft Zune Desktop / Zune 4.8 experience: content-first Metro design, pivot navigation, Smart DJ, tri-state heart ratings, and a dynamic Now Playing canvas.
Formerly named Not-Zune. Built with Avalonia UI on .NET 8.
Dorado rebrand: renamed from Not-Zune, new organization and packaging metadata.
